items.title: Chico Freeman interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: I was playing with Elvin Jones, I was working in his band.

ctx.x: Can you describe what you were doing at that time?
I was playing with Elvin Jones, I was working in his band.
But I mean musically, is it possible to put a description on the kind of music.
